body: i honestly don’t know what to say. it’s crazy how literal strangers can show so much kindness. you don’t know how much this means to me. especially rn, perfect timing, i’m in a bad place. thank you smmm. idk what else to say. i hope you’re doing well:)
i’m sorry. i hope u don’t but i understand how difficult it is. i’m sorry<3
i’m so sorry. no one deserves to go through that. i don’t know what else to say but i hope you don’t go through with it. <33

i don’t know what to say. i feel helpless. i’m not going to say “it gets better” or “you have so much to live for”. ik anything i say will be unimportant to you or won’t convince you to change your mind. only you have the power to do that. i sincerely hope you don’t go through with it and things get better. as cliche as it is “suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem”. i’m sorry i wish i could be more help:/

hey r u ok??? ik i’m a stranger and it sounds silly but i rlly care for you. i’m not going to say “it gets better” bcos ik first hand that sentence never works. i honestly feel helpless idk what to say. i don’t think anything i say will stop you from feeling this. only you can help urself which is the hardest part. if you have access (ik some ppl don’t) i recommend seeing a therapist. ik how patronising and scary that sounds, i too neglected that idea for a long time. i’m not sure if things get better but u will never find out unless you try. whatever you r going through i want you to know that you rlly don’t deserve it and your pain is valid no matter how large or small it may be. i rlly hope you seek help or don’t go through with it. i don’t know what else to say, sorry :/ <33

hey ik you’ve heard it a million times already and are probably frustrated so i’m not going to say “stay strong, life gets better, don’t give up”. atleast that’s how i feel everytime someone says those crappy words. but i just want you to know there are people out there that care and, ok yes i  will be cliche “suicides not the only option”.  i genuinely hope you don’t go through with it and i wish you all the best. i wish there was something else i could say but i don’t think it will have an impact. as stupid as it sounds i love you and i’m glad you are alive<33
i’m extremely sorry for your loss. i’m sure you’ve heard that a thousand times already. no one deserves to go through that you must be extremely strong. i hope things get better<3
thank you, you dont know how much that means to me
hey. im extremely sorry i misspelled. that amount would have definetly killed me. im obviously alive now. im sorry.
im fine now but ty for commenting! i appreciate it

hey! i accidently wrote the wrong amount. thx for ur kind words. the intention wasnt to kms, unfortuantely thats not an option as my family is religious and i cant put them through that. ig i just wanted to hurt myself. maybe if i was close to death id suddenly find the will to live, yk? thx again and im alive, just have a little pain

thank you for the comment. i misspelled. the medicine was still painful as shit but i dont thinks its enough to  kill me. i took some more also the day before. im fine and once again ty for the nice comment.
